data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 门口藏不住的礼物
data.description: 妹妹家门口，龙卷穿薄荷色夹克和藏蓝长裤，脚尖略离地面，把礼物纸袋藏在身后。袋角露出来后，她不耐烦地挪了挪手，另一只手已经抬起准备敲门；绿卷发下的表情强硬得有点刻意。
data.action: 挪手藏好礼物袋，抬起另一只手准备敲门。
data.promptProse: Outside her sister's apartment, Tatsumaki hovers just above the floor, hiding a gift bag behind her mint bomber jacket. When one paper corner shows, she shifts it impatiently while her other hand prepares to knock. A cream turtleneck and navy trousers remain neat above white sneakers. The medium view includes the closed door and corridor wall. Warm hall light reveals green curls and bag creases, with a separated shoe shadow below.
